statement: For a based ambient-null plane homeomorphism loop, the median contractions on the nonopen orbits form equivariant orbit-preserving bijections. Their inverses are exactly the median constructions for the inverse loop. Both the bijections and their inverses take each point to a value on its original loop track, and consequently are jointly continuous, uniformly in homotopy parameters, at the common fixed-point stratum.
depends_on: C.27 line median contraction and naturality; C.28 orbit classification; C.29 circle winding comparison and descended contraction; explicit inversion identities in the lattice of increasing line homeomorphisms
manuscript_passages: §23; folios140–141; scans279–281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; fixed-stratum gluing reduction for C.12
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: the domain is explicitly the closed union of nonopen loop-group orbits.
notes: Inversion exchanges minimum and maximum, and preserves the three-entry median by its self-dual lattice expression. The resulting exact inverse identity gives track control for both directions. Compact-family equicontinuity proves continuity at all common fixed points. Continuity at nonfixed line/circle strata and any relative open-orbit contraction remain unproved, so no global surface homeomorphism homotopy is asserted.
